description: Agentic document platform providing APIs for parsing, extracting, splitting, classifying, and editing documents at scale.
auth_notes: API keys are passed via headers (e.g., Bearer token or custom headers) for authenticating API requests.
credential_notes: Developers can sign up self-serve for the Standard pay-as-you-go plan, which includes $150 in free trial/usage credits.
api_notes: Extensive API coverage for document parsing (r-1 and r-1 mini models), structured data extraction, file splitting, classification, and editing.
mcp_notes: Reducto provides an official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for integrating directly into AI agent workflows.
rationale: Reducto features a comprehensive public API, self-serve credentials with free trial credits, and an official MCP server, making it fully ready to integrate into an AI agent toolkit today.

evidence.note: Main platform overview and documentation link showing API availability and tools.
